Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，一个男人觉得植物很有意思。他叫神农。有的植物吃了以后他的肚子疼死了，可是有的吃了以后很舒服。他找很多植物。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the stomach pain, add a physical reaction to show how serious it feels: “他在地上躺着，难受得不得了。”
2. At the first mention of plants, add one visual detail that explains why he finds them interesting: “有的植物开着黄色的花，又大又漂亮。”
3. Add an inner thought after he becomes ill to show his worry: “他想：‘我会不会生病？’”

ideas.reason: This adds a clear physical reaction that fits his severe stomach pain.
This gives a simple concrete detail about the plants without changing the story.
This adds a natural worried thought after he feels ill.
